meta.title: What design teams want to see in a portfolio
method: Pulled 265 live designer job posts (product, UI/UX, brand, and design manager roles) from 98 companies through their public job boards. 182 of them explicitly mention a portfolio. No company contributes more than 15 posts to any one role type: Amazon (39 near-duplicate posts left out).
Gathered the "show us evidence of…" requirement lines too, so the map captures what a portfolio needs to prove, not just the "send a link" mentions.
Wrote each line worth keeping on a sticky note as a verbatim quote, then sorted the 204 notes by similarity until 19 clusters and 5 themes emerged.
Named each cluster with the words the posts themselves use, then sized it two ways: how often those words describe the portfolio itself, and how often they appear anywhere in the post.
